claim.claim-text: a semiconductor layer (11, 12, 13, 13a, 14) made of silicon carbide having a first face provided with a trench (3) and a second face opposite to the first face; a gate electrode (41) provided in the trench (3); and an insulating layer (5) provided in the trench (3) so as to insulate the semiconductor layer (11, 12, 13, 13a, 14) and the gate electrode (41) from each other, wherein the semiconductor layer (11, 12, 13, 13a, 14) includes a n-type SiC semiconductor substrate (11) with a high-concentration impurity, a n-type SiC semiconductor layer (12) with a low-concentration impurity provided on the n-type SiC semiconductor substrate (11), and a p-type SiC semiconductor layer (13) provided on the n-type SiC semiconductor layer (12), the trench (3) is formed so as to penetrate through the p-type SiC semiconductor layer (13) and to reach the n-type SiC semiconductor layer (12), the p-type SiC semiconductor layer (12) includes a close portion closer to the second face of the semiconductor layer (11, 12, 13, 13a, 14) than the trench (3) is, the p-type SiC semiconductor layer (13) includes a channel region formed along the trench (3) and held in contact with the n-type SiC semiconductor layer (12), impurity concentration in the channel region is lower than impurity concentration in the close portion, and the n-type SiC semiconductor layer (12) and the close portion of the p-type SiC semiconductor layer (12) defines a bottom boundary (K2) at a lower level than the trench (3), and a field concentration takes place at the bottom boundary (K2) when a reverse bias is applied, thereby a breakdown of the insulating layer is avoided.

2. The SiC semiconductor device according to claim 1, wherein the impurity concentration of the close portion is 1×10<17> cm<-3> to 1×10<20> cm<-3>, and the impurity concentration of the channel region is 1×10<16> cm<-3> to 1×10<19> cm<-3>.
3. The SiC semiconductor device according to claim 1, wherein the n-type SiC semiconductor layer (12) is epitaxial grown layer.
4. The SiC semiconductor device according to claim 1, wherein the n-type SiC semiconductor layer (12) is in direct contact with the bottom of the trench (3).

5. The SiC semiconductor device according to claim 1, further comprising an additional p-type SiC semiconductor layer (15) formed below the bottom of the trench (3), wherein the additional p-type SiC semiconductor layer (15) does not exist at the corner of the trench (3) below the channel region.

6. The SiC semiconductor device according to claim 1, further comprising a high-concentration semiconductor region (13a) of the p-type, the high-concentration semiconductor region (13a) including a part embedded in the p-type SiC semiconductor layer (13) and spaced apart from the n-type SiC semiconductor layer (12),

wherein the bottom boundary (K2) is located under the high-concentration semiconductor region (13a) in a depthwise direction of the trench (3) and extends along a widthwise direction perpendicular to the depthwise direction, wherein the bottom boundary (K2) is greater in size in the widthwise direction than the high-concentration semiconductor region (13a).
